comparison.objective: Mask a band before coating, versus commission a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply and conform masking material to boundaries versus rigid-body hex-key alignment, collar adjustment, counterholding, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Band coverage and coating exclusion are title-implied; no body/specs, dimensions, adhesion, or leakage tolerance is supplied. Candidate measures physical stopping and retention.
comparison.reason: Mask placement—likely involving deformable material—tests coverage and adhesion, not rigid mechanical tuning.
